turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: The "Big Black Lollipop" experiment, or the Milgram Obedience Experiment, was a controversial study that explored how people can be influenced to obey authority figures, even to the point of causing harm, by showing participants they were administering electric shocks to another person when in reality, no shocks were being delivered. It raised ethical concerns about the manipulation of human behavior in the name of scientific research.
